name: release-review
title: Release review pack
for_each: select r.id,p.name||' '||r.version as name from releases r join projects p on p.id=r.project_id order by name

sections.title: Release readiness
sections.note: Draft evidence pack. Checks cover recorded evidence, not legal certification or software security.

sections.title: Components
sections.sql: select name,version,effective_license,reviewer,valid_until,blockers from component_checks where release_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select rv.actor,rv.decision,rv.reason,rv.evidence,rv.created_at from reviews rv join components c on c.id=rv.component_id where c.release_id=$1 order by rv.created_at

name: attribution
title: Attribution evidence draft
for_each: select r.id,p.name||' '||r.version as name from releases r join projects p on p.id=r.project_id order by name

sections.title: Status
sections.sql: select project,version,readiness,blockers from release_readiness where id=$1
sections.note: DRAFT. Verify original source files and obligations before distribution. Demo evidence is fictional.

sections.title: Recorded texts and notices
sections.sql: select c.name,c.version,c.effective_license,c.blockers,rv.copyright_text,rv.license_text,rv.notice_text,rv.change_notice from component_checks c left join reviews rv on rv.id=c.review_id where c.release_id=$1 order by c.name

name: handover
title: Licence review handover
for_each: select r.id,p.name||' '||r.version as name from releases r join projects p on p.id=r.project_id order by name

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,status,resolution from tasks where release_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Sign-off history
sections.sql: select actor,reason,created_at from signoffs where release_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: A later component review, expiry or new task can invalidate a prior sign-off. Check current readiness.
